description: This file defines the MaintenanceService class, which provides methods for managing maintenance-related operations such as retrieving purgeable entities, obtaining access strategies, accessing employee data with GDPR considerations, and extracting data based on employee numbers within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: MaintenanceService
classes.description: Service class for handling maintenance operations, including GDPR data access and entity management.

methods.name: getPurgeableEntities
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entities that can be purged, parsed from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: getAccessStrategy
methods.description: Creates and returns an access strategy object based on the provided class name, strategy type, and strategy info array.

methods.name: accessEmployeeData
methods.description: Accesses employee data for GDPR compliance, managing database transactions and handling exceptions.

methods.name: getMaintenanceDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the MaintenanceDao object.

methods.name: extractDataFromEmpNumber
methods.description: Extracts data from the database based on employee number and table.
